body.p: . tests/xsd/driver/, the developer tool sxml-xsd-test (list, run), public API only, a sibling of sxml-qt4 and sxml-xslt-test that links sxml_qt4_driver_library.

item.p: Shared, not copied (the drivers' common mechanisms moved into the QT4 driver's library): the test budget (budget.h, from the copies in test_run.c and xslt_execution.c), the test selection over a test catalog interface (selection.h, from xslt_selection.c; the XSLT and XSD catalogs each adapt to it in a dozen lines), one slice-test script (run-slice-test.cmake, SPEC optional), documents in another suite's namespace and attributes in a namespace (document.h), report areas configurable (report.h, empty = 's). The QT4 commands keep their own walking for now (a later cleanup can move them onto selection.h).

Names: suite.xml names test sets only by href and testSet/@name repeats (Assert, CTA, TargetNS, VC, Zone), so a test set is named DIRECTORY-without-Meta "-" FILE-without-extension (saxon-Assert, ms-DataTypes_w3c, nist-NISTXMLSchemaDatatypes); the prefix is the contributor area of the report and the dashboard. A test is GROUP/TEST (unique per test set, xsts.xsd). tools/run-xsd.sh derives the same names from suite.xml with sed.

Scope, per element (refines 's count): xsts.xsd says the version tokens of testSet, testGroup and test each mean "run if any of them is supported", so each level must apply on its own; or-ed the three levels together. Supported tokens and their classes as lists them; an unknown token is an unsupported class. Measured: 41,518 in scope (15,329 schema tests, 26,189 instance tests; NIST 23,170, Microsoft 14,363, Sun 1,606, Saxonica 1,375, IBM 919, W3C WG 41, Oracle 26, Boeing 18), 20 fewer than 's 41,538: 19 XSD 1.0 instance tests of wgMeta/substitution-groups.testSet, five of which name files that do not exist, and the 1.0 group of a Saxonica set. Gate groups: datatypes 30,598, structures 8,626, XSD 1.1 2,294. The introspection set is listed and not run; expected indeterminate or none applying, status queried or disputed: not run, out of scope.

Run: each applicable test in a processor of its own (QT4 limits) through the test budget, its documents read (a missing one is an error); then not run, "XSD not implemented", until 5.4 and 5.7 fill the one marked place in xsd_test_run.c (plan in xsd_test_run.h: schema documents as TEXT with file:///SUITE-PATH, strict validation with a counting report sink, a group without a schema test validated against the built-in components alone, a group whose schema fails makes its instance tests fail). Report spec XSD11, program sxml-xsd-test.

Slice: tests/xsd/slice.txt, 147 in-scope tests, one per test set plus the rest in proportion; baseline 0. A full release run takes 45 s (one process per test set; NIST, 23,170 tests in one file, is the longest).
